name: Cryptstalker Armor Doesn't Make Itself...
label: Quest
description: Cryptstalker Armor Doesn't Make Itself...: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: How would you like to earn yourself one of these shiny coins?

I've got a little problem that you might be able to help me with, friend. You see, I make Cryptstalker armor for those daft enough to venture into Naxxramas. While they supply me with the core material requirements for the armor, I always run out of the crypt fiend parts. Bring me back a bundle of parts and I'll pay you with an insignia - usable at the quartermaster.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, that'll do nicely, friend. Remember, I'm always accepting more parts. For every bundle you bring me, I'll reward you with an insignia.
